notes.title: City freeride video preview
notes.content:
The first video preview has finally arrived! It has some imperfections as there are still many things to improve in the game.


     All HUD warning lights are working, but since there's no battery charge, ABS or engine condition indication yet, these lights stay inactive
     Proper boost pressure calculation is not implemented and you can notice that
     Fuel consumption formula does not include things like fuel quality or air/fuel ratio, it's something to be improved later
     Mileage has a so called "mileage factor", because ingame time runs faster. This behavior repeats odometer from the Street Legal
     PRND display is an option for automatic transmissions and you can always switch back to the ordinary digital gear indication
     Car lights are switched on manually and I think the game should include an automatic option
     Rev limiter has adjustable cut delay
     Vehicle physics and gearbox behavior are not final and will be updated later

[previewyoutube=ACtpAHcjJN4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:
Huge thanks to everyone who keeps supporting Street Tuning Evolution on Patreon!

Especially to:

You are our heroes! We'd also like to thank those fans of garage tuning and street racing who have added the game to their wishlist, it's over 15000 Steam wishlist additions so far!

Everything you do inspires us to continue working on the game. It's still a hard time and there are a lot of challenges to fight against: development team is very small and people join and leave frequently, funding is extremely limited, game has high quality standards, there are also other projects that need attention, etc. We believe in success anyway ːthepistonː

So what's happening now? Arists spent a lot of time on preparing the assets, so now we have something to play with. Entire project is split into several smaller games that we'd like to combine into a single demo and release to our ULTIMATE Patreon supporters. Their feedback will help improving a public early access version of Street Tuning Evolution in the future.
